name: jordanrendric/claude-video-vision
description: A video perception plugin plus MCP server. The sample skill, video-perception, works from base64 images, transcription, timestamps, and audio events to give an agent video understanding.
install: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/jordanrendric/claude-video-vision, then /plugin install claude-video-vision; the MCP server auto-installs via npx from npm. A git clone plus claude --plugin-dir route is also documented.
